messages:
olivia (prod-support): fyi getting an escalated ticket from Acme — their SIEM has holes for audit events starting ~00:30 UTC. customers see missing create/delete events and alignment gaps. forwarding logs show some 'truncated batch' errors. any ideas? :eyes:

mike (eng-security): can you paste the forwarder error? is this the SIEM side returning a 4xx or our exporter timing out?

olivia (prod-support): here's a snippet from exporter logs around the time:

```json
{"ts":"2026-03-17T00:31:12Z","level":"error","svc":"audit-exporter","msg":"publish failed","reason":"batch_truncated","batch_size_bytes":33554432,"events":468,"export_id":"exp-789","err":"upstream 413 Payload Too Large"}
```

jasmine (sre): hm 413 -> upstream (customer SIEM) rejecting oversized payloads. historically we chunk at 32MB but looks like a big spike in per-event size (maybe extra metadata). did we change compression? :thinking_face:

kevin (platform): we had a config roll 1:14 UTC that toggled "enable_batch_compression": false for JSON exports to reduce CPU on small instances. @olivia can you confirm the timeline vs deploy?

support-bot: deploy-bot posted: "config-rollout audit-exporter v2.8.1 -> enable_batch_compression=false (canary)" at 1769000440

olivia (prod-support): matches timeline. customers started seeing issues right after. sample event payload shows added KMS envelope metadata which increased event size by ~1.2KB each. when batched this pushes many batches >32MB.

mike (eng-security): OK that explains truncated batches. Two concerns: 1) dropped events -> compliance gaps, 2) replay/backfill might touch PII and needs KMS/HSM confirmation. we need repro steps and short-term mitigation.

olivia (prod-support): repro steps I used:

1) hit audit API to generate traffic: `for i in {1..500}; do curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d @sample_event.json $AUDIT_SVC/api/v1/events; done`
2) watch exporter logs with `kubectl -n infra logs deploy/audit-exporter --tail=200`
3) look for `batch_truncated` / `upstream 413` entries

sample curl payload is small but our instrumentation adds kms_envelope metadata server-side so it grows.

kevin (platform): immediate mitigation options: re-enable compression on exporter (gzip), or reduce batch_max_bytes to 16MB so upstream accepts chunks. both are config flips. also can throttle producer to avoid giant batches.

jasmine (sre): short term I recommend: 1) flip enable_batch_compression=true (low risk), 2) set batch_max_bytes=16MB for SIEM-forwarder route, 3) create DLQ/metrics alert for batch_truncated>0. I'll prepare a canary.

mike (eng-security): for the compliance side: if we replay events from S3 we must ensure envelope KMS metadata is preserved so customer HSM/KMS can decrypt on their side. Also confirm we do NOT log sensitive fields to observability while debugging. audit: please list keys that are required in S3 manifest (kms_key_id, envelope_alg).

olivia (prod-support): confirmed S3 objects include `kms_key_id` and `envelope_header` fields. S3 stores cipher text only; we only have KMS key IDs not plaintext keys. but we should still route replay through customer's SIEM endpoint to validate decryption. opening a compliance ticket now.

mike (eng-security): assign owner for followup tasks: patch config rollback, replay plan, compliance signoff. I'll own code patch. jasmine will own rollout/monitoring. olivia will coordinate with customer and verify missing event list. kevin will own backfill infra.

deploy-bot: release note: "audit-exporter v2.8.2 -> re-enable gzip + chunking, batch_max_bytes=16777216" deployed to canary at 1769005634, plan rollout at 1769006434 :shipit:

olivia (prod-support): after canary we saw no further 413s and customer reports gap narrowed. still building a backfill to fill ~2k events. :thumbsup:

jasmine (sre): followups:
- add metric `audit.export.batch_truncated.count` and alert when >0 for 5m
- add histogram `audit.export.batch_size_bytes` p50/p95/p99 to better understand distribution
- add test in CI that simulates KMS-enveloped event + batching

kevin (platform): infra/backfill notes: we can replay from s3 prefix `s3://redwood-audit/backfill/2026-03-17/` using existing replay tool, but we need an allowlist for target SIEM endpoints (compliance). I'll queue an infra job.

mike (eng-security): also create a short postmortem for records (impact, root cause: config flip disabled compression + larger kms metadata causing batches >32MB -> upstream 413 -> truncated/dropped batches). include mitigation/rollback timeline and compliance signoff.

olivia (prod-support): tagging @acme on the ticket, sending them the audit window and our remediation plan. thanks all. :raised_hands:

(reacts: :eyes: from mike, :heart: from jasmine)
